paragraphs.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models and world action models (WAMs) have advanced robotic policy learning by building on pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) and video generative models (VGMs), respectively. Yet VLAs learn without explicit supervision from future world states, while WAMs that condition actions on predicted futures incur extra inference cost and let visual prediction errors propagate into actions. We present Forward Dynamics Models (FDM), a family of robotic action models that couples action and future world-state prediction through an action-to-future paradigm. Future prediction is conditioned on action features, never the reverse: end-to-end training lets ground-truth future states supervise the policy through these features, while prediction errors cannot propagate into actions. At inference, FDM skips future generation entirely, avoiding its computational cost. The paradigm is backbone-agnostic, and we instantiate it with both VLM and VGM backbones. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate the effectiveness of FDM across both backbone families, achieving a state-of-the-art 99.4% average success rate on LIBERO and absolute gains of up to 13% over VLA and WAM methods on real-world tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界动作模型（WAM）分别基于预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）和视频生成模型（VGM），推动了机器人策略学习的进步。 然而，VLA 无需来自未来世界状态的显式监督即可学习，而将动作条件于预测未来的 WAM 则会带来额外的推理成本，并可能导致视觉预测误差传递到动作中。 我们提出了前向动力学模型（FDM），这是一类机器人动作模型，通过“动作到未来”的范式将动作与未来世界状态的预测耦合在一起。 未来预测以动作特征为条件，而非相反：端到端训练使得真实未来的世界状态能够通过这些特征对策略进行监督，同时预测误差无法传递到动作中。 在推理阶段，FDM 完全跳过未来状态的生成过程，从而避免了其计算成本。 该范式不依赖特定的骨干网络，我们使用 VLM 和 VGM 两种骨干网络对其进行了具体实现。 在模拟环境和真实机器人上的实验表明，FDM 在这两类骨干网络上均展现出有效性，在 LIBERO 数据集上实现了 99.4% 的先进平均成功率，并在真实世界任务中相比 VLA 和 WAM 方法获得了最高达 13% 的绝对性能提升。

paragraphs.en: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) and video generative models (VGMs) offer two complementary foundations for robotic action learning. Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt VLMs to map current observations and task instructions directly to actions ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026b ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) , following the action-imitation paradigm ( Chi et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ) ( Figure 1 (a) ). While effective, this paradigm learns what to do without explicit supervision on what happens next , leaving the rich signal in future world states unused. World action models (WAMs) instead build on video backbones to model visual dynamics alongside actions ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Pai et al., 2025 ; Bi et al., 2026a ) . A prevalent design first predicts future world states and then infers actions from them in an inverse-dynamics manner ( Li et al., 2026b ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026c ; Ma et al., 2026b ; AgiBot Research Team et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2024 ) ( Figure 1 (b) ). However, future prediction is inherently error-prone, since every visual detail matters across both space and time. Placing it before action prediction means its errors accumulate and amplify into the actions, and future generation also adds substantial inference overhead. Other works predict future frames and actions jointly or in parallel ( Ye et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , align policy features with future embeddings ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , or train an action model and an action-conditioned world model side by side ( Cen et al., 2025b ) . These designs motivate studying the specific contribution of future supervision through action features, beyond supervision through shared context.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿视觉-语言模型（VLMs）和视频生成模型（VGMs）为机器人动作学习提供了两种互补的基础。 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将 VLMs 应用于将当前观察结果和任务指令直接映射到动作（Kim et al., 2024；Intelligence et al., 2025；Yu et al., 2026b；NVIDIA et al., 2025），遵循动作模仿范式（Chi et al., 2025；Zhao et al., 2023）（图 1 (a)）。 尽管这一范式有效，但它学习的是“该做什么”，而非对“接下来会发生什么”进行显式监督，导致未来世界状态中的丰富信号未被利用。 相比之下，世界动作模型（WAMs）基于视频骨干网络，将视觉动态与动作一同建模（Hu et al., 2024；Feng et al., 2025；Pai et al., 2025；Bi et al., 2026a）。 一种常见的设计是首先预测未来世界状态，然后以逆动力学的方式从中推断出动作（Li et al., 2026b；Zhao et al., 2025；Ye et al., 2026c；Ma et al., 2026b；AgiBot Research Team et al., 2026；Tian et al., 2024）（图 1 (b)）。 然而，未来预测本质上容易出错，因为每个视觉细节在空间和时间上都至关重要。 将其置于动作预测之前意味着其错误会累积并放大到动作中，而且未来生成还会带来显著的计算开销。 其他研究则联合或并行地预测未来帧和动作（Ye et al., 2026c；Wang et al., 2026b），将策略特征与未来嵌入对齐（Zheng et al., 2025），或者并行训练一个动作模型和一个以动作为条件的世界模型（Cen et al., 2025b）。 这些设计促使我们研究通过动作特征引入的未来监督的具体贡献，而不仅仅是通过共享上下文进行的监督。

paragraphs.en: We investigate whether a policy can benefit from future supervision without ever depending on predicted futures. To this end, we introduce Forward Dynamics Models (FDM), a family of robotic action models built on an action-to-future learning paradigm. Borrowing the classical notion of forward dynamics ( Jordan & Rumelhart, 1992 ; Agrawal et al., 2016 ) , the mapping from state and action to the next state, FDM connects action learning with future world state prediction: given the current world state and task instruction, FDM jointly predicts actions and future world states with asymmetric conditioning. Future prediction reads action features, while action prediction cannot access future information. The model is trained end to end, so the future-prediction loss backpropagates through these action features into the policy. Action-to-future specifies this one-way information dependency within joint prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究一个问题：一项策略是否可以在未来监督中受益，而无需依赖任何预测的未来状态。 为此，我们引入了前向动力学模型（Forward Dynamics Models, FDM），这是一类基于“动作到未来”学习范式的机器人动作模型。 借鉴经典的前向动力学概念（Jordan & Rumelhart, 1992；Agrawal et al., 2016），FDM 将状态和动作映射到下一个状态，从而将动作学习与未来世界状态的预测联系起来：给定当前的世界状态和任务指令，FDM 通过非对称条件约束联合预测动作和未来世界状态。 未来预测会读取动作特征，而动作预测无法访问未来信息。 该模型采用端到端训练方式，因此未来预测的损失会通过这些动作特征反向传播到策略中。 “动作到未来”机制明确了联合预测过程中这种单向的信息依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold: (i) We introduce FDM, a novel family of robotic action models that learns in an action-to-future manner during training, with future supervision flowing into the policy through its action features, and requires no future prediction at inference; (ii) We build VLM- and VGM-based instantiations of FDM, demonstrating its backbone flexibility; (iii) Experiments in simulation and on real robots show that FDM achieves strong or competitive performance across VLM- and VGM-based settings, and analysis shows that it avoids the error propagation of future-conditioned designs.

paragraphs.en: Vision-language-action models. VLA models adapt pretrained vision-language models to predict robot actions ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Yuan et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026b ; Black et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Qu et al., 2025 ; Contributors, 2025 ; Cai et al., 2026b ; Shukor et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Recent approaches also predict future observations or their latent representations ( Cen et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2026b ; Cheang et al., 2024 ; Cen et al., 2025a ; Lv et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , using future prediction as a learning objective or an input to action generation, as in visual chain-of-thought policies ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Our FDM w/ VLM builds on π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and conditions future prediction on action features and the current context, establishing an action-to-future dependency.

sents.zh: VLA 模型将预训练的视觉-语言模型用于预测机器人动作（Wang et al., 2026a；Yuan et al., 2026a；Ye et al., 2026b；Black et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026；Yu et al., 2026a；Zhang et al., 2026b；Zheng et al., 2026；Qu et al., 2025；Contributors, 2025；Cai et al., 2026b；Shukor et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Recent approaches also predict future observations or their latent representations ( Cen et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2026b ; Cheang et al., 2024 ; Cen et al., 2025a ; Lv et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , using future prediction as a learning objective or an input to action generation, as in visual chain-of-thought policies ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 近期的方法还预测未来观察结果或其潜在表示（Cen et al., 2025b；Ma et al., 2026b；Cheang et al., 2024；Cen et al., 2025a；Lv et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026a；Hu et al., 2026；Kang et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025），将未来预测作为学习目标或动作生成的输入，例如视觉思维链策略（Zhao et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Our FDM w/ VLM builds on π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and conditions future prediction on action features and the current context, establishing an action-to-future dependency.
sents.zh: 我们的 FDM w/ VLM 基于 π₀.₅ \pi_{0.5}，并将未来预测建立在动作特征和当前上下文之上，从而建立了从动作到未来的依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: World action models. Video models provide visual dynamics representations for robot control ( HaCohen et al., 2024 ; Ali et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) . WAMs use these representations to condition action decoding ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Pai et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026c ) or jointly predict video and actions ( Bi et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026c ; Li et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Extensions combine predicted outcomes with value estimates for planning ( Bi et al., 2026b ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , while asynchronous designs improve efficiency through different denoising budgets or prediction horizons ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026a ) . Our FDM w/ VGM places future prediction downstream of action features, keeping the action path independent of predicted video. Deployment therefore omits future-video computation while retaining current-observation processing.
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型。 视频模型为机器人控制提供视觉动态表示（HaCohen 等，2024；Ali 等，2025；Wan 等，2025）。 世界动作模型利用这些表示来对动作解码进行条件约束（Hu 等，2024；Pai 等，2025；Ma 等，2026c），或联合预测视频和动作（Bi 等，2026a；Ye 等，2026c；Li 等，2026a；Wang 等，2026c；Zhou 等，2026；Tian 等，2026；Zhu 等，2025）。 扩展方法将预测结果与价值估计相结合以进行规划（Bi 等，2026b；Kim 等，2026；Chen 等，2026），而异步设计则通过不同的去噪预算或预测时域来提高效率（Guo 等，2026；Cai 等，2026a）。 我们的 FDM w/ VGM 将未来预测置于动作特征之后，使动作路径独立于预测视频。 因此，部署时可以省略未来视频的计算，同时保留当前观测的处理。

paragraphs.en: Our two instantiations implement these dependencies with a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture ( Liang et al., 2024 ) ( Figure 3 ). Each expert processes its tokens with self-attention, while MoT connects the experts through their hidden states. The generation expert reads action features as conditions for future prediction; the action expert cannot read future visual states. This restriction also applies to indirect paths: context features accessible to the action expert must remain independent of generation-branch tokens ( Figure 8 ). Thus, future supervision can train the policy without making future prediction an input to action generation.

paragraphs.en: FDM w/ VLM, our VLM-based instantiation, uses a context expert, an action expert, and a generation expert. The context expert plays the role of the VLM in a conventional VLA, extracting semantic features from the current images and instruction. The action expert reads these context features to generate actions. The generation expert combines the Wan VAE latents ( Wan et al., 2025 ) of historical and current images with context features and action features to directly predict the clean latent of one future image per camera view.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate task success in simulation on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . LIBERO covers the Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long suites, while RoboTwin evaluates bimanual manipulation under clean and randomized conditions. On both simulation benchmarks, we compare FDM w/ VLM with the VLA methods π 0 \pi_{0} and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and FDM w/ VGM with the WAM methods Motus ( Bi et al., 2026a ) and LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Both FDM instantiations are trained without robot policy pretraining (P.T.). To assess performance beyond simulation, we use a dual-arm ARX-X5 robot for five tasks: loading a drawer with a charger and a block, then closing it (Drawer); packing a scarf and a flower into a box and closing it (Box); inserting two shuttlecocks into a tube (Shuttlecock); stacking two cups on a three-cup base (Cup); and stacking two small blocks on a larger block (Block). Figure 4 illustrates the five real-world tasks with two frames per task. The methods compared in the real world are π 0 \pi_{0} and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} for the VLM-based model, and DreamZero and FastWAM-Joint (a future-conditioned WAM) for the VGM-based model. FastWAM-Joint shares the architecture of FDM w/ VGM, differing only in its attention mask, which reverses the direction of cross-expert attention. We use the same FastWAM-Joint implementation for real-world task success ( Section 4.2 ), future-perturbation analysis ( Section 4.4 ), and efficiency evaluation ( Section 4.5 ). The hardware setup, teleoperation interface, and detailed task descriptions are provided in Appendix D .

paragraphs.en: Full FDM raises average success from 89% to 96% for the VLM-based model and from 78% to 83% for the VGM-based model, gains of 7 and 5 percentage points over Stop-gradient, respectively. In each backbone family, Full improves success on four tasks and matches Stop-gradient on the remaining task. For the VLM-based model, the largest gains occur on Drawer and Box, at 15 and 10 percentage points; for the VGM-based model, the largest gain is on Cup, at 10 points. C and D retain the same forward action conditioning: for identical parameters, inputs, and noise, sg ⁡ ( H a ) \operatorname{sg}(H_{a}) and H a H_{a} yield identical forward predictions. Their difference is whether future-loss gradients pass through the action-feature interface during training. The resulting success-rate gains therefore support the value of this backward supervision for the deployed action-only policy.

paragraphs.en: Adding a context-only future objective increases average success from 83% to 87% for the VLM-based model and from 66% to 72% for the VGM-based model (B vs. A). Full FDM further improves over this control by 9 and 11 percentage points, respectively (D vs. B), with higher success on all five tasks in both backbone families. Relative to action-only training, the total gains reach 13 points for the VLM-based model and 17 points for the VGM-based model (D vs. A). Thus, visual co-training provides a useful learning signal, and connecting future prediction to action features yields additional gains. D vs. B captures the combined contribution of forward conditioning and backward supervision, while D vs. C isolates the benefit of backpropagation through H a H_{a} .
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用上下文的未来目标使基于 VLM 的模型的平均成功率从 83% 提升至 87%，基于 VGM 的模型则从 66% 提升至 72%（B 对比 A）。完整的 FDM 在此基础上进一步提升了 9 和 11 个百分点（D 对比 B），并且在两种主干模型家族中，所有五个任务的成功率均更高。与仅使用动作的训练相比，总增益在基于 VLM 的模型中达到 13 个百分点，在基于 VGM 的模型中则达到 17 个百分点（D 对比 A）。因此，视觉联合训练提供了有用的学习信号，而将未来预测与动作特征相结合则带来了额外的提升。D 对比 B 体现了正向条件化和反向监督的共同贡献，而 D 对比 C 则单独揭示了通过 H a H_{a} 进行反向传播所带来的益处。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows that FastWAM-Joint’s action error generally increases with perturbation strength across simulation and real-world tasks. At α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 , action error rises by 4.44% on LIBERO and 5.52% on RoboTwin; all five real-world tasks also show increases, ranging from 0.22% on Box to 1.17% on Cup. Small perturbations yield slight decreases on LIBERO and Box, but all seven settings exhibit higher action error at α ≥ 0.5 \alpha\geq 0.5 , with the largest increase at α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 . These results show that perturbations to the generated future can affect FastWAM-Joint’s action error even when the observation and noised action chunk are unchanged at the intervention step.
paragraphs.zh: 图6显示，在模拟任务和真实世界任务中，FastWAM-Joint的动作误差通常会随着扰动强度的增加而上升。 当 α = 1.0 时，LIBERO上的动作误差上升了4.44%，RoboTwin上则上升了5.52%；所有五个真实世界任务也均出现误差上升，幅度从Box任务的0.22%到Cup任务的1.17%不等。 较小的扰动在LIBERO和Box任务上会导致轻微下降，但在 α ≥ 0.5 的所有七种设置中，动作误差均有所升高，其中 α = 1.0 时的增幅最大。 这些结果表明，即使干预步骤中的观察数据和含噪声的动作片段保持不变，对生成的未来状态施加扰动仍可能影响FastWAM-Joint的动作误差。

paragraphs.en: We introduced FDM, a family of robotic action models built around action-to-future learning. Actions and future world states are jointly predicted with asymmetric conditioning: future prediction reads action features, while action prediction remains independent of predicted futures. Future prediction errors supervise these action features through backpropagation. Ground-truth future states thus supervise the policy during training, while action-only inference skips future generation. Our VLM- and VGM-based instantiations realize this principle via future-image latent regression and future-video flow matching, respectively. They achieve strong LIBERO performance and improve success on RoboTwin and five real-world tasks. Controlled ablations and gradient analysis examine backward future supervision, while future-latent perturbations test action sensitivity to prediction errors at inference. FDM w/ VLM retains comparable action latency, while FDM w/ VGM reduces latency relative to FastWAM-Joint.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FDM，这是一类围绕“动作-未来”学习构建的机器人动作模型家族。 动作与未来世界状态通过非对称条件约束进行联合预测：未来预测会读取动作特征，而动作预测则独立于预测的未来状态。 未来预测误差通过反向传播对这些动作特征进行监督。 因此，真实未来状态在训练期间对策略进行监督，而仅基于动作的推理过程则会跳过未来状态的生成。 我们基于 VLM 和 VGM 的实现分别通过未来图像潜在变量回归和未来视频流匹配实现了这一原则。 它们在 LIBERO 任务中取得了优异表现，并提升了在 RoboTwin 及五个真实世界任务中的成功率。 受控的消融实验和梯度分析检验了反向未来监督机制，而未来潜在变量的扰动则测试了推理过程中动作对预测误差的敏感度。 使用 VLM 的 FDM 保持了相当的动作推理延迟，而使用 VGM 的 FDM 相比 FastWAM-Joint 降低了延迟。

paragraphs.en: Both instantiations connect action learning and future prediction through layer-wise attention between experts. Each expert maintains its own feature transformations, while attention allows it to read the permitted representations from other experts. The future-prediction branch therefore reads action features throughout the network, rather than the final numerical action output. Below, we describe the visual representations, attention permissions, and computation retained at deployment.

sents.en: Thus, the additional temporal context supports future prediction during training without becoming an input requirement for the deployed policy.

paragraphs.en: A frozen Wan VAE encodes each image independently into a 48-channel latent grid with a spatial downsampling factor of 16. Independent encoding keeps the future target separate from the historical and current inputs. For the generation expert, a learned channel projection followed by a strided convolution converts the two context grids into a shorter sequence of visual tokens. After transformer processing, features at corresponding spatial locations are averaged across the two temporal positions separately for each view. A transposed convolution restores the latent-grid resolution, and normalization followed by a linear projection produces the predicted future latent. The visual objective averages latent reconstruction errors over valid camera views. This is direct regression: the generation expert predicts a clean latent in one forward pass, with a fixed zero time condition and no visual denoising loop.
paragraphs.zh: 一个冻结的 Wan VAE 将每张图像独立编码为具有 48 个通道的潜在网格，空间下采样因子为 16。 独立编码使未来目标与历史和当前输入保持分离。 对于生成专家，经过学习的通道投影随后接一个步长卷积，将两个上下文网格转换为更短的视觉令牌序列。 经过变换器处理后，每个视图在对应空间位置的特征会在两个时间位置上分别取平均值。 转置卷积恢复了潜在网格的分辨率，随后通过归一化和线性投影生成预测的未来潜在状态。 视觉目标在有效相机视图中对潜在重建误差进行平均。 这是一种直接回归：生成专家在一次前向传播中预测一个干净的潜在状态，使用固定的零时间条件，且没有视觉去噪循环。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 illustrates the asymmetric attention mask, and Table 6 details the token groups in each instantiation. paragraphs.en: The same connection carries supervision in the reverse direction during optimization. paragraphs.en: At deployment, the VLM-based policy uses its context and action experts to denoise an action chunk; the additional generation expert and its VAE processing are unnecessary for control. The VGM-based policy first processes the current observation and caches its keys and values at each transformer layer. Each action-denoising step reuses this cache, updating only the action stream without allocating or processing future-video tokens. The generation expert’s observation processing is retained because it supplies the visual context for action generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在部署时，基于 VLM 的策略会利用其上下文和动作专家来对动作片段进行去噪；而额外的生成专家及其 VAE 处理过程则无需用于控制。 基于 VGM 的策略首先处理当前观察结果，并在每个 Transformer 层中缓存其键值对。 每个动作去噪步骤都会复用该缓存，仅更新动作流，而无需分配或处理未来视频中的标记。 生成专家的观察处理过程会被保留，因为它为动作生成提供了视觉上下文。

paragraphs.en: The generation expert uses the Wan video backbone, and a frozen Wan VAE encodes the spatially composed camera views into video latents. The current-frame latent provides the visual condition, while the subsequent latents represent V V . Spatial patches of these latents form the generation expert’s tokens. The action expert projects each vector in the noised action chunk A τ a A_{\tau_{a}} into an action token and uses the action flow-matching time τ a \tau_{a} for time conditioning. Both experts receive text features of the task instruction L L through their own cross-attention layers. Their transformer layers have matching attention-head dimensions and are connected at corresponding depths, while retaining separate projections, normalization layers, and feed-forward transformations. An action velocity head produces u ^ a \widehat{u}_{a} from the action features, and the generation expert predicts the future-video velocity.

paragraphs.en: The current-frame latent is restored after every video update. Consequently, future conditioning operates throughout sampling: the action expert reads partially denoised future representations at each step, without waiting for a completed video rollout. Returning only the action chunk omits video decoding, but still requires future-video latent computation during denoising. paragraphs.en: The video backbone is initialized from Wan2.2-TI2V-5B. The action expert is randomly initialized and has not undergone pretraining; the initialization checkpoint loaded by the saved configurations stores these random initial weights. Both experts have 30 layers, with hidden dimensions of 3072 for the video backbone and 1024 for the action expert. Training uses cached UMT5 text features with a maximum text length of 128 tokens, and compilation is disabled. Action and future-prediction losses both have unit weight. Future frames are sampled every four steps, and the action prediction horizon is 32 for both benchmarks. The video and action schedulers each use 1,000 training timesteps and a shift of 5.0 for training and inference; action timesteps use the configured beta_tau sampling scheme. paragraphs.en: We collect 150 demonstration trajectories per task using VR teleoperation, reserving three trajectories for offline validation and using the remaining 147 for training. Each arm uses a 10-dimensional action vector comprising three position components, a six-dimensional rotation representation, and one gripper command, yielding a 20-dimensional bimanual action space. Actions are normalized using task-specific mean and standard deviation statistics.

paragraphs.en: Real-world evaluation follows a blinded protocol: human evaluators are unaware of the identity of the model being evaluated. Task success is determined by a human evaluator based on whether the specified task goal is achieved. A trial is counted as a failure if it times out or a human evaluator judges that the robot cannot continue to complete the task. Object placements vary across demonstrations and evaluation trials, with slightly different placement distributions during training and evaluation. The task-specific placement variations and goals are described below.
paragraphs.zh: 真实世界评估遵循盲测协议：人类评估者不知道正在评估的模型的身份。 任务成功与否由人类评估者根据指定任务目标是否达成来判断。 如果试验超时，或人类评估者判断机器人无法继续完成任务，则该试验计为失败。 物体放置位置在不同演示和评估试验中有所差异，训练和评估阶段的放置分布略有不同。 特定于该任务的放置变化和目标将在下文中进行描述。

paragraphs.en: The goal is to place both a charger and a block inside a drawer and leave the drawer closed ( Figure 10 ). The drawer is initially closed, and both objects are outside the drawer in the workspace. The charger and block positions are randomized, while the drawer base position varies slightly. The robot first grasps the drawer handle and pulls outward to expose the interior. It then picks up each object, moves it over the open drawer, and releases it inside. Finally, the robot pushes the drawer back into the cabinet. This sequence couples articulated-object manipulation with pick-and-place: the opening must provide sufficient clearance for insertion, and the placed objects must not obstruct the drawer’s closing motion. The desired final state has both objects contained in the drawer and the drawer fully closed.
paragraphs.zh: 目标是将充电器和方块都放入抽屉中，然后关闭抽屉（图 10）。 初始时抽屉是关闭的，两个物体都在工作空间中，位于抽屉外部。 充电器和方块的位置是随机生成的，而抽屉底座的位置则略有变化。 机器人首先抓住抽屉把手并向外拉，使内部空间暴露出来。 接着，它分别拿起每个物体，将其移动到打开的抽屉上方，然后放入其中。 最后，机器人将抽屉推回柜内。 这一序列将可变形物体的操作与抓取放置相结合：开口必须为放入物体提供足够的空间，且放置好的物体不能阻碍抽屉的关闭动作。 期望的最终状态是：两个物体都位于抽屉内，且抽屉完全关闭。

paragraphs.en: The goal is to pack a scarf and a single flower into a box and close its lid ( Figure 11 ). Initially, the box is open, with the scarf and flower lying on the tabletop beside it. It then grasps the flower by its stem, transfers it over the box, and places it on top of the scarf. After both objects have been deposited, the robot brings the hinged lid down over the opening. The task combines handling a deformable textile with positioning an elongated object and manipulating a lid. The contents must fit within the box so that neither the scarf nor the flower obstructs closure; the desired final state has both objects enclosed and the lid closed.
paragraphs.zh: 任务目标是将一条围巾和一朵花放入盒子中，然后合上盖子（图 11）。 初始时，盒子是打开的，围巾和花则放在盒子旁边的桌面上。 盒子、花和围巾的位置会略有不同。 机器人首先将围巾抬入盒子中，并在盒内释放它。 接着，它抓住花的茎部，将其移至盒子上方，并放置在围巾上面。 两个物品都放入后，机器人将铰链盖子合在开口上。 这项任务结合了处理可变形织物、定位长条物体以及操作盖子等多个步骤。 盒内物品必须能够完全容纳，确保围巾和花都不会妨碍盖子关闭；最终的理想状态是两个物品都被封闭在盒中，且盖子已合上。

paragraphs.en: The goal is to insert two shuttlecocks into a shuttlecock tube ( Figure 12 ). The tube and the two shuttlecocks are initially separate on the tabletop. The tube position varies slightly, and the shuttlecocks are placed in front of the right arm with varying positions and orientations. One arm grasps and holds the tube horizontally, presenting its open end to the other arm. The other arm picks up a shuttlecock, aligns its narrow end with the opening, and advances it into the tube. The robot then repeats the pickup, alignment, and insertion sequence for the second shuttlecock while maintaining the tube’s pose. This task requires coordination between the arm holding the receptacle and the arm performing insertion, as well as alignment of each shuttlecock with the tube axis. The desired final state has both shuttlecocks inside the tube.
paragraphs.zh: 任务是将两个羽毛球插入羽毛球管中（图 12）。 初始时，羽毛球管和两个羽毛球在桌面上彼此分离。 羽毛球管的位置略有变化，而羽毛球则以不同的位置和朝向放置在右臂前方。 一只手臂水平握住羽毛球管，并将其开口端朝向另一只手臂。 另一只手臂拿起一个羽毛球，将其窄端与管口对齐，然后将其推进管内。 接着，机器人在保持羽毛球管姿态不变的同时，对第二个羽毛球重复抓取、对齐和插入的步骤。 这项任务需要持容器的手臂和执行插入动作的手臂之间进行协调，同时还需将每个羽毛球与羽毛球管的轴线对齐。 理想的最终状态是两个羽毛球都位于羽毛球管内部。

paragraphs.en: The goal is to build a two-tier structure with three paper cups in the bottom row and two cups in the upper row ( Figure 13 ). Initially, two cups are placed on the left and three on the right, with randomized positions within their respective sides. Starting from cups distributed across the tabletop, the robot picks up and arranges three cups side by side to form the base. It then lifts each of the remaining two cups and places it above a gap between adjacent base cups. Each upper cup must be supported by the cups beneath it, so the spacing of the base determines the available placement locations. The robot must control both the approach and release to avoid displacing the lightweight cups or disturbing an earlier placement. The desired final state is a freestanding five-cup structure that remains stable after the grippers withdraw.
paragraphs.zh: 目标是在底部一行放置三个纸杯，在上方一行放置两个纸杯，从而构建一个双层结构（图 13）。 初始时，左侧放置两个纸杯，右侧放置三个纸杯，且它们在同一侧内的位置是随机分布的。 从散落在桌面上的纸杯开始，机器人会拿起三个纸杯并排摆放，以构成底座。 接着，它会抬起剩下的两个纸杯，分别放置在相邻底座纸杯之间的空隙上方。 每个上层纸杯都必须由下方的纸杯支撑，因此底座的间距决定了可放置的位置。 机器人必须控制接近和释放的动作，以避免移动这些轻质纸杯或干扰之前放置好的位置。 理想的最终状态是一个独立的五杯结构，在机械手撤离后仍能保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: The goal is to stack two small blocks, red and yellow, on a larger blue base block ( Figure 14 ). The blocks are initially separated on the tabletop. The two small blocks are randomly positioned, while the large central base block position varies slightly. In the illustrated sequence, the robot first picks up the red block, positions it over the blue block, and lowers it into contact before releasing it. It then picks up the yellow block and places it on top of the red block to complete the three-block stack. Each placement requires aligning the new block with the supporting block and withdrawing the gripper without disturbing the existing stack. The desired final state is a stable tower containing all three blocks in the prescribed order.
